videos.title: Empty nyjer feeder? Here's the real reason your finches vanished. Moisture gets trapped inside tradi
videos.description:
Empty nyjer feeder? Here's the real reason your finches vanished. Moisture gets trapped inside traditional tube feeders, clumping the seed and growing mold and bacteria finches instinctively avoid. Mesh-sided and sock-style feeders solve this by letting air circulate, so they dry out fast even though they get wet quicker in rain. Add Feeder Fresh to any feeder style to absorb excess moisture, and after a rain shower, flip mesh or sock feeders upside down to resift the seed and dry it out quickly.

videos.title: Heavy Rain Means Your Bird Feeders Need Attention, and Fast
videos.description:
Heavy rain means your bird feeders need attention, and fast. Once seed gets wet and moldy, birds will stop visiting altogether. In this video, I'm sharing two easy cleaning methods: a DIY vinegar soak followed by a hot water and Dawn dish soap scrub, or a soak using a commercial cleaner like Mr. Bird or Carefree Enzymes. For tube feeders specifically, a long brush like the one from Songbird Essentials makes all the difference. Everything shown is available at ForTheWildBirds.com under Crinda's Picks. Happy Birding!

Squirrels or blackbirds giving you trouble and baffling isn't an option? Golden safflower keeps the pests out while cardinals, chickadees, nuthatches, doves, and finches keep visiting. 🐦
